project.name: Rakazo
project.summary: Open source self-hosted AI teammates with memory, routines and their own computers. A pnpm/turbo monorepo with a Hono API, worker, web, desktop and mobile clients, and an adapters package that holds the agent loop.

flows.title: One agent turn
flows.description: From a user message to the reply.

steps.note: User sends a message in a thread.
API creates a run for the thread.
A job wakes the run on the worker.
Assembles history, instructions, tools and model.
Pi runtime streams the model response.
Provider returns tokens and tool calls.
Tool calls are gated, run, and fed back until done.
Run completes and the reply is stored and delivered.

flows.title: Sign in with a ChatGPT or Claude subscription

steps.note: Hook starts and polls the sign-in.
ChatGPT device code flow against auth.openai.com.
Stored credential is resolved at run time and refreshed.
